policy.direction: Arrows run from a proposed input capability toward a proposed downstream use. They are not a promised chronology.
policy.provenance: Every arrow is grounded in its two original descriptions. Optional checked papers are context only, never proof of the whole relationship.
policy.required: No required dependency is asserted: the broad source ambitions do not justify claiming a full milestone universally necessary for another.
policy.scope: A first editorial tree of possible relationships between the original future milestones. No milestone achievement, date or experimentally established prerequisite is asserted.

types.accelerator: Could reduce effort, constraints or evaluation cost; not required.
types.alternative-route: Another research approach toward the target; routes may combine and are not sufficient alternatives.
types.enabling: Could provide a component or method; not established necessary or sufficient.
